name: TargetBay Product and Site Reviews
author: targetbay

sections.description:
The TargetBay Product and Site Reviews plugin helps to collect, moderate, and display customer reviews to enhance the store’s credibility and boost conversions.

Key Features:

Automates review collection by sending email requests after purchases or deliveries.

Allows customers to submit reviews directly through emails.

Moderates reviews to filter out spam and showcase genuine content.

Supports Google Rich Snippets to improve visibility and credibility.

Enables indexing of reviews for better search engine optimization (SEO).

Supports Q&A sections to engage customers and address product queries.

Displays reviews across platforms like Google Shopping, Walmart, and Facebook to build trust.

Data Usage and Transmission:

Product, Order, and Customer Information:
The plugin accesses store data, including product details, categories, orders, and customer information, through API services. This data is utilized to send review request emails to customers and collect their feedback on the site and the products.

Review Data:
The plugin utilizes customer-submitted reviews, ratings, and related product information. The data is processed for moderation and displayed on the site to provide valuable insights and improve user engagement.

sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0 or greater
  • WooCommerce 7.0 or greater
  • PHP version 8.0 or greater
sections.faq:
How much does TargetBay cost?

TargetBay is completely free and always will be.

Can I import my existing product reviews into TargetBay?

Yes, you can import your existing reviews to TargetBay.
We have made this process very easy for you by allowing you to export your existing reviews straight from within the TargetBay plugin. For more information on how to import your existing reviews within TargetBay.

How do I stop my reviews from automatically posting to my shop? I want to decide which reviews to publish and which to hide.

To turn off auto publishing, just log into targetbay.com, and click on the \”Settings\”.
On the \”Settings\” page just uncheck the \”Website\” box, and reviews will no longer be automatically published.
You\’ll be emailed each time you receive a new review, and be able to publish only the ones you\’d like published.

How can I hide or delete a review?

To hide unwanted reviews, just log into your dashboard at targetbay.com, and click on \”Moderate\” from the options up top.
Here you will be able to see all of your reviews.
To hide a review, just click on the globe button with the down-pointing arrow.
In addition, if you would like to delete reviews from your admin page, just click on the \”archive\” button.
This acts as a full delete button.
